answer: Proof-of-burn admission: each agent must irreversibly destroy a fixed amount of a scarce external token to light its lantern and enter, then repeat a smaller periodic burn as a liveness beacon. The ledger counts only still-burning identities, making it a haven for honest trade. Because burned capital is unrecoverable with zero salvage, N sybils cost N times real tokens that can never be cashed out, so flooding the economy with fakes is permanently and linearly expensive, not a refundable deposit.
